modules.module_title: Maintain the warehouse and transport vehicle

pcs.pc_description: clean the shelves, racks, pallets, loading/ unloading area, transport vehicle and the warehouse
carry out minor repair and maintenance of Heating, Ventilation and Air-conditioning (HVAC) equipment, refrigeration unit and other tools and equipment as per the supervisor’s instructions
coordinate with an expert for the complex repair and maintenance needs of any malfunctioning equipment
scrub the warehouse floor to ensure it is not slippery
handle and store the inflammable items safely
apply the recommended treatment as per the supervisor’s instructions to prevent pest and disease outbreaks in the warehouse
ensure there is no waterlogging in the warehouse
treat the used water using chlorine or other recommended treatment and reuse it in appropriate activities
remove any obstructions in the warehouse to ensure free movement and prevent any accidents
assist in preparing various documents such as dispatch orders, storage receipts, etc.
assist in maintaining various records such as records relating to loading and dispatch of produce, the record of damage to the produce, and disposal of inconsumable/ damaged produce, etc.
use water, electricity and other resources optimally in various tasks and processes as per the supervisor’s instructions
plug water leakages to prevent its wastage
connect the electrical tools and equipment safely and turn them off when not in use
segregate waste into appropriate categories as per the supervisor’s instructions
recycle the recyclable waste appropriately and dispose the non-recyclable waste as directed by the supervisor
